net.network_type_help: full: all evidence channels (co-expression, text mining, pathway co-annotation…), two proteins being functionally related does not mean they bind. physical: only interactions with direct physical-binding evidence — fewer edges, higher confidence. Commonly paired with medium confidence (0.4) in literature.
net.no_common: No common targets found between the two datasets.
net.no_enrich: No significant enrichment terms (adjusted p < 0.05) — try lowering the confidence threshold.
net.no_hubs: No hub genes met the threshold.
net.no_interactions: STRING returned no interactions above the confidence threshold. Try lowering the confidence (e.g. 0.4), then Build Report again.
net.no_interactions_physical: No interactions found in the physical-binding network: physical evidence is far sparser than functional associations. Switch back to Functional (full), or lower the confidence (e.g. 0.4), then Build Report again.
net.params_changed: Parameters have changed — click Build Report to re-analyze.
net.prog.caption: Build progress
net.prox_caption: Degree-matched randomization ({n_perm} permutations, seed {seed}, bin width {bin_size}) on the STRING interactome LCC. d_c = mean closest distance from drug targets to disease proteins; Z < 0 means closer than random expectation.

net.prox_degenerate: Random distribution is degenerate (all permutations share the same distance) — Z-score is undefined, only the empirical p-value is shown.
net.prox_excl_caption: Excluding the {n} drug∩disease shared targets — tests proximity beyond direct drug action (Z < 0 here rules out a shared-target-only explanation).
net.prox_excl_unavailable: Drug targets fully cover the in-LCC disease set — no overlap-excluded variant.
net.prox_low_coverage: ⚠️ Too few mapped targets for proximity (drug {d_in}/{d_tot}, disease {s_in}/{s_tot}, threshold {thr:.0%}) — skipped to avoid unreliable results.
net.prox_nosupport: Z ≥ 0 — no network-level proximity evidence for this drug–disease pair.
net.prox_not_built: ⚠️ Interactome cache not built — run `python scripts/build_interactome.py` first, then re-run this analysis.
net.prox_subheader: 🌐 Network proximity test (drug vs disease targets)
net.prox_support: ✅ Z < 0 — drug targets lie significantly closer to disease proteins than degree-matched random expectation. Supports the drug–disease association.
net.rwr_caption: Ranks all interactome genes by steady-state random-walk probability from the seed set (α={alpha}, restart to seeds, LCC only). High-ranking non-seed genes are candidates in the seed module's network neighborhood — they are not seeds themselves.
net.rwr_enrich_nosig: Degree-matched correction: annotated targets do not score significantly above degree-matched random genes (z={z:.2f}, p={p:.4f}) — the ranking may reflect hub degree.
net.rwr_enrich_sig: ✅ Degree-matched correction: the {n} annotated targets score significantly higher than degree-matched random genes (z={z:.2f}, p={p:.4f}) — the ranking is not a hub-degree artifact.
net.rwr_expand_clamp: ⚠️ RWR expanded targets is capped at 100 — the entered value {n} was adjusted to 100.
net.rwr_expand_help: Run RWR from the target seeds on the background interactome and union the top-N non-seed genes into the query set (range 0–100, default 30, aligned with literature cross-target scale). STRING network, topology, hubs, modules and enrichment use the expanded set; proximity and GSEA keep the original targets.
net.rwr_in_report: 💾 RWR CSVs (both seed sides) were auto-run with Build Report and included in the ZIP: `{dir}`
